{{Quotation|[[Notorious Foe: Fragment of Antiquities]]|Beware! The Fragment of Antiquities has been spotted patrolling the depths of the Sepulchre of Dragrimmar. Humans and children should give this cave a wide berth until a Norn warrior with the strength of Bear, the cunning of Wolf, and the eyes of Raven ventures into the dark, icy recesses of this cavern to slay the beast and claim its bounty.}}

[[Fragment of Antiquities]] is an [[Elemental]] [[boss]] that appears in the far northwest corner of [[Sepulchre of Dragrimmar]]. It is also a boss that has to be killed in the [[Anything You Can Do]] [[quest]].
